_help: Blockbench projects exported by tools/bbmodel_to_geo.py. Each model: source .bbmodel (relative to the repo), output name, groups left out, and texture variants (suffix: texture name in the project; written as <name>_<suffix>.png).
_author_model: lakitu_cloud.bbmodel (repo root) is the author's earlier Lakitu + cloud project, kept as is. To use it again, point the lakitu and lakitu_cloud entries' source at it.
